steps.text:
The Porvoo council notice is built and recorded: a bilingual band along the bottom of the frame that switches between Finnish and Swedish on its own. The operator can jump to either language, hold it, and resume. It passes `noacg validate` with no errors or warnings. I looked at all 57 coverage frames and 5 close-ups; one gap, below, I fixed and checked with a separate screenshot. Nothing was saved to a library; the host takes the recorded version.

**How it looks:** a calm deep-navy band, 1536px wide and centred, inside title-safe. It has a brick-red edge on the left, a nod to Porvoo's red riverside sheds. Each language shows a small uppercase heading over a two-line notice. A footer line reads "Porvoon kaupunki · Borgå stad", and small **SUOMI · SVENSKA** tags at the top right show which language is on air. Both languages sit in the same slot, so the band is always as tall as the longer Swedish text and doesn't change size when the language changes.
